【构图与机位】 采用腰部以上裁切的半身中景景别。使用 35mm 镜头高机位微俯拍，主体居中，右侧前景探入一片鲜亮阔叶形成局部遮挡与景深前移。设定 f/2.8

【场景与空间】
自然有机的户外庭院花园空间，严格遵循微俯视透视守恒。右侧前景斜伸出一片翠绿大叶；中景环绕浓密灌木与斑驳树干；左后方背景隐约可见黑色铁艺护栏与栏外模糊街景，保留真实自然的庭院空间层次。

【色彩与光影】
采用户外树叶缝隙洒下的晴日斑驳自然阳光照明，严禁人工闪光压光。画面高光柔润过渡，树荫暗部通透无灰翳。色彩按体量由背景苔藓墨绿灌木与前景嫩绿阔叶统领，主体由象牙白金长发与纯白蕾丝裙构成纯净亮色，面颊点缀柔和胭脂粉。直射阳光在发顶、右侧蕾丝袖与胸前投下明亮光斑，右侧绿叶在左侧发梢与手指投映出清透的嫩绿漫反射色光；面颊透出毛细血管微弱漫透光活体血色，鼻尖浮现柔润漫反射弱高光，刘海与脖颈处凝聚柔和接触微阴影。

【质感与风格】
唯美画意派柔焦人像摄影流派。中画幅数码配合柔光镜光学结像，色彩清透温润。具备浪漫的光学光晕漫溢特征，受强光照射的白金发丝与白色蕾丝边缘泛起柔和朦胧的高光光雾，成片极具梦幻呼吸感。

未竟之美 × 具象主题开放抽卡 × 完整与缺失的视觉关系 × 多元艺术媒介

从《石头记》的未完成性、断臂维纳斯的残缺之美及艺术史中的未完成作品获得启发，探索形体、结构、材料与时间中的未竟美学。

优先选择能在单张画面中直观呈现未完成状态的具象主题，让已完成或保存的部分与未竟部分形成审美张力。

【开放式抽卡】

每张独立组合以下变量，各组保持开放。

1. 具象主体：
自由探索具有鲜明形态与审美价值的主体，优先选择未完成状态容易通过单张画面辨识的对象。

2. 未竟机制：
根据主体自由探索不同的未完成状态，每张确定一种主要机制。机制应与主体及所选媒介的逻辑相符。

3. 完整与未竟：
根据主体和未竟机制，设计已完成或保存的部分与未竟部分之间的关系。自由变化其位置、比例、边界和过渡方式，使未竟状态融入主体自身的形态与结构。

4. 艺术媒介：
自由选择与主体及未竟机制相适应的真实或实验性媒介，遵循对应的制作方式、物理特征与变化逻辑。

5. 构图与呈现：
根据主体与未完成状态，自由选择景别、视角、空间、背景和光线，呈现作品的形态及其未竟特征。

【核心视觉逻辑】

未完成状态清晰可辨，主体保持可识别性与审美价值。未竟状态具有合理的结构与材料依据，并保留与其形成过程相符的痕迹。

完整与未竟的比例自由变化，不固定对半分割，也不要求每张都有破损。边界、过渡与空间关系自然可信，让观众能够想象未呈现的部分或最终完成的样子。

叙事、象征与情绪可以自然产生，以具象视觉表现为优先，不依赖文字说明。

【视觉品质】

遵循所选媒介的造型、材质、光影与制作逻辑。形体清晰，完成部分具有可信的精细度，未完成部分保留真实材料或工艺特征。

细节的来源、尺度与分布合理，减少无意义碎纹、异常斑驳、密集杂点、过度锐化和装饰堆积。避免随机破坏、人体结构错误、画面模糊及缺乏依据的材质混杂。

【系列规则】

n=10，连续生成10张独立单图，每次生成1张。每张探索不同的具象主题、未竟机制、艺术媒介与构图。

优先形成不同的整体轮廓、材料关系与视觉结构，减少主体类型、未竟呈现方式及画面组织的重复。每张都是独立成立的艺术作品，共同呈现未竟之美的不同形式。

p:
Create one independent high-end editorial poster for each uploaded photo. Process each photo separately. Never combine photos into a collage, grid, split-screen, or multi-photo composition.

FORMAT
Strict 3:4 vertical composition, horizontally divided into two exactly equal 50/50 sections. Top 50% = original photography; bottom 50% = flat editorial illustration. Keep the overall design premium, clean, art-directed, visually balanced, and rich in negative space.

TOP 50% — ORIGINAL PHOTO
Treat the uploaded photo as the single source of truth. Preserve the original subject, identity, facial features, body proportions, pose, expression, clothing, objects, environment, composition, colors, spatial relationships, lighting, shadows, depth, and photographic texture. Do not redesign, replace, beautify, distort, stretch, duplicate, or reinterpret the subject. Only subtle professional color grading is allowed, with the feel of an independent art magazine, premium travel editorial, or exhibition photograph. If more space is needed, naturally extend the existing background without altering the subject.

BOTTOM 50% — FLAT EDITORIAL ILLUSTRATION
Reinterpret the same photograph as a playful, slightly awkward Korean-inspired flat editorial illustration. Identify and preserve the most recognizable subject, silhouette, pose, action, key relationships, and narrative of the original scene. Simplify them into rounded, slightly exaggerated geometric shapes with clean solid fills and rough, imperfect black hand-drawn outlines featuring subtle wobble, uneven thickness, broken edges, and imperfect contours. Remove photorealistic lighting, shadows, perspective, and material textures. Avoid conventional cartoon or photorealistic styles. Aim for a contemporary Korean children's book, independent magazine graphic, or playful editorial artwork.

COMPOSITION
Keep one dominant focal point with secondary objects used only as accents. Create relaxed visual rhythm through varied scale, slight misalignment, overlaps, partial cropping, irregular spacing, and subtle asymmetry. Allow some shapes to extend beyond or overlap the composition. Use bold color blocks and generous negative space. Preserve key visual relationships without reproducing every detail. The illustration should feel designed, relaxed, and intentionally imperfect, never mechanically traced or cluttered.

COLOR
Extract the photograph's most distinctive colors and reinterpret them as a limited palette of high-purity, high-saturation flat colors. Use bold, clean color blocks and bright youthful contrasts. No gradients, realistic shadows, muddy gray tones, glossy effects, complex blending, or excessive texture. The palette should feel cheerful, energetic, childlike, warm, and visually confident.

TYPOGRAPHY & EDITORIAL TEXT
Generate English text inspired by the photo's theme, action, emotion, atmosphere, or story. Integrate typography naturally into the illustration.

MAIN TITLE: 2–4 English words, placed near the upper illustration area. Use playful, slightly handwritten, imperfect lettering; irregular alignment or capitalization is allowed.

SUBTAGLINE: One short, restrained English phrase below the title.

LOCATION / YEAR: Small editorial line in the lower-middle area. Use a verified location/year when known; otherwise use the subject, activity, event, or travel theme. Never invent a location.

POETIC MICRO-CAPTION: A short 1–2 line poetic or playful phrase, placed naturally within negative space, beside a color block, along an edge, or on the visual axis.

SERIES NUMBER: Small, subtle editorial numbering such as “No.01” in a corner.

Typography may follow subject contours, align with color blocks, occupy negative space, overlap shapes slightly, rotate subtly, or use irregular spacing/cropping. Readability must remain strong. Title can be expressive; supporting text should stay clean and restrained.

ART DIRECTION
Combine real travel photography × playful flat illustration × premium editorial design × Korean graphic sensibility × travel diary aesthetics. The result should feel bright, youthful, cheerful, warm, playful, slightly quirky, sophisticated, and collectible—like a limited-edition travel art print or contemporary illustrated travel diary, not a generic tourist poster.

**Cinematic close-up portrait from the chest upward, shot on an 85mm lens with shallow depth of field.** A woman with the features of the reference image tilts her head back, eyes closed, her expression suspended between surrender and release. She wears a long-sleeve blouse constructed entirely of layered, deep matte black raven feathers—each barb and vane catching a thin rim of diffused light against the smoke. Large black hoop earrings hang motionless, a hard geometric counterpoint to the organic dissolution around her. Her loose hair is caught in an updraft, strands lifting and twisting forward as if pulled by an invisible current. Along the edges of her silhouette, feathers and hair begin to unravel into wet black ink splatters, drifting charcoal dust, and thin wisps of dark smoke; fine black ink flecks migrate across her cheekbone, jawline, and neck, settling into the pores and fine hairs rather than sitting on top of the skin. The background is a dense, layered field of smoky gray atmosphere, with thicker plumes rolling behind her and thinner veils drifting through the foreground, so that her face remains the only sharp anchor in the frame. Lighting is low-key and directional—a soft key from camera-left wraps her features while a cool rim light separates the feather blouse from the smoke, creating deep chiaroscuro without crushing the detail in the black feathers. Desaturated monochrome palette with the faintest warm undertone in the skin, cinematic film grain, high-resolution, atmospheric depth, surreal and ethereal mood.

四张是雪夜山里的小木屋、街角还没关门的小书店、湖边栈道尽头的小屋、乡下没人的小火车站。第一次出图蓝色太暗，墙也画成了米色，后来在提示词里把蓝调亮、把墙也写成蓝的，才是刚入夜那种感觉。

提示词分两段。上面「Visual system」管颜色比例、灯光只能有一两处、刀刮的笔触，别动它。下面「New subject」写你想画的地方和哪扇窗亮着，改这一段就行。

图1 提示词，直接复制：

Create an image with the following visual system. Replace the subject as specified.

Visual system (light, color, composition, medium, mood):
一幅竖幅 3:4 的蓝色夜景厚涂油画，用调色刀堆出来的完成态手绘油画。接近人眼高度的平视远景，主体建筑体量偏在画面一侧，占约一半宽度、可以局部出框，另一侧留出大片低细节的夜空和开阔地面或水面做负空间；地平线或水平线压在画面下三分之一附近，前景是粗粝的地面，中景是主体，远景高度概括。整体明度中等偏亮，是刚入夜的蓝调时刻那种饱和的青蓝、蔚蓝，天空像一整片明亮的钴青色颜料，不要暗沉的藏青、午夜深蓝或接近黑色的大面积暗部；冷青蓝的环境光柔和地罩住全画，天上不出现月亮、星星或强逆光；全画只有一到两处暖光：主体的一扇窗或一扇门透出橙黄灯光，在门口近处地面或水面投下一小片短而破碎的金橙反光，暖光不扩散、不照亮整片环境，不要路灯串、霓虹或多扇亮窗。颜色秩序：明亮饱和的青蓝到湖蓝铺满天空和开阔处，约五成五；钴蓝、群青和深海蓝塑造建筑、地面和阴影，约四成，建筑的墙面、屋顶、树和地面也都画成蓝色调，不要米色、棕色、灰色的墙或木头本色；琥珀橙到金黄只有约百分之四，集中在那一两处亮窗和它的反光里；最深处是深靛蓝不是中性黑，蓝色内部靠明度和冷暖差拉开远近，不要被处理成一层统一的蓝色滤镜。颜料很厚：刀脊、压痕、横向拖抹、刮痕和断续露底清楚可见，天空用宽而交叠的刮面，水面和地面用横向短刮痕，墙面有粗拙的块面，建筑轮廓略带手工的歪斜，形体高度概括成几个大色块，不画砖缝、木纹、瓦片、书脊和石板这类细节，远景只是一两道蓝色块面，暖光区域也保留厚涂痕迹，不要光滑的数字渐变、照片质感或均匀的浮雕滤镜。人物如果出现只是很小的深色背影，不画五官。整体安静、孤独，像深夜里只剩这一盏灯还醒着。画面里不要任何文字、招牌字、签名或水印。

傍晚发一套能直接拿去用的节气海报。上半是米白纸，下半一张照片，中间压一个蓝色大英文词，左边竖着一行红色手写，右下两个竖排的节气字。

四张是这一段的节气：小雪、立冬、大雪、冬至。每张三处字，大词 SNOW / WINTER / WHITE / NIGHT，一行手写，一个节气名，字都写进提示词里了，照抄不容易错。

换节气只改主体那段：照片拍什么、三处字写什么。照片里要有一根竖着的东西伸进纸面，电线杆、树、灯杆都行，版式就靠它撑着。

图1 提示词，直接复制：

Create an image with the following visual system. Replace the subject as specified.

Visual system (light, color, composition, medium, mood):
【画面风格】一张竖幅约 2:3 的日系杂志风海报，是实景照片加排版，不是插画。画面上半约 45% 是带细纸纹的米白色纸面，下半是一张实景摄影照片，照片和纸面之间是一条水平的直边分界。照片里有一个竖向的主体从下面一直伸进上半的纸面，伸出来的部分也保持照片质感，像海报的骨架。一个深青蓝色的粗体无衬线英文大词横排在画面中部偏右，正好压在纸面和照片的分界线上，字的下半截落在照片里。画面左侧有一行很大的砖红色英文手写花体，竖着沿左边从上往下写，笔画流畅，局部压在照片主体上。右下的照片区域里，两个米白色的大号汉字竖排，细黑体，干净醒目。照片是自然光，饱和度偏低，带一点胶片颗粒，天空通透。色彩只用米白、深青蓝、砖红三种加照片本身的颜色。文字只允许主体里指定的三处，必须逐字照写、拼写正确，不要多出别的字，不要日期、小字段落、网址、品牌和 logo。留白充足，安静，像一本冬天的杂志封面。

New subject:
【主体】小雪。照片是冬天田野边的一排芦苇和一根老木电线杆，芦苇顶上落着薄薄一层雪，天空是淡淡的蓝灰色，远处一条低低的山线。电线杆从照片底部伸进上方的纸面。文字三处：深青蓝粗体大词「SNOW」；砖红手写「a little snow today」；竖排汉字「小雪」。全图只有这三处文字。

模型：GPT Image 2.5

下午三点半发一组特写。只画动物半边脸，一只大眼睛放在中间，眼珠里装着一个它自己的小世界，背景全黑，毛一缕一缕画出来。

四张换的是动物和它眼里的东西：狐狸眼里是下雪的松林，猫头鹰眼里是星空下的树林，小鹿眼里是枫林和小溪，野兔眼里是月光下的蒲公英。

脸一定要切掉一半，眼睛占三分之一左右才有冲击力。背景压黑，眼睛上那道白色高光别漏掉。

图1 提示词，直接复制：

Create an image with the following visual system. Replace the subject as specified.

Visual system (light, color, composition, medium, mood):
【画面风格】一张竖幅约 2:3 的数字厚涂特写插画。动物的半边脸从画面一侧压进来，出血裁切，只看得到一只眼睛、一部分鼻子和脸颊，眼睛放在画面中间偏上，又大又圆，约占画面三分之一。毛发用很多细长的笔触一缕一缕画出来，边缘松散，方向顺着脸的结构走，几根细白的胡须或长毛伸出画外。重点在眼睛：虹膜像一颗透亮的玻璃球，里面清楚地映出一个和这只动物有关的微缩小场景，场景有前后景和自己的光，眼睛上方有一道弧形的白色高光，下眼睑有一点湿润的反光。背景是接近纯黑的深色，和暖色毛发形成强烈的明暗对比，另一侧大面积留黑。光线是上方偏左的暖光，照亮额头和眼周，暗部沉进黑底。色彩：毛发以暖橙、焦糖、奶白为主，背景黑，眼里的小世界用它自己的颜色，是整张最精细、最亮的地方。笔触清楚，像平板上的厚涂，不要照片，不要 3D 毛发渲染，不要卡通大头，不要文字和签名。

New subject:
【主体】一只赤狐的半边脸，橙红色的毛，白色的脸颊和细长的白胡须。琥珀色的眼睛里映着一片正在下雪的松林，林间一条小路，路尽头一盏很小的暖灯。

Create a vertical 9:16 mixed-media editorial poster. A folded petrol-blue quilt is the dominant photographic object, its open fold forming a small sheltered reading nook on a pale cool-gray paper background. Preserve the quilt's recognizable shape, visible cotton fibers, stitched channels, soft thickness and believable weight. A single tiny illustrated adult in their forties sits inside the fold, knees comfortably bent, holding an open unlettered book. Their mustard cardigan, rust trousers and charcoal socks have delicate colored-pencil shading. Their face has mature proportions and a quietly absorbed expression.

The quilt remains photorealistic while the person remains visibly hand-drawn, with expressive graphite outlines, subtle warm skin shading and individual hair strokes. Do not turn the person into a rendered toy. The adult leans gently against the fabric wall; their feet rest on the lower quilt fold. Add coherent contact shadows and natural overlap where the drawing touches the real fibers. A loose thread at the fold gives scale without creating clutter.

Light the scene from the upper right with soft window light, cool shadows and restrained warm highlights. Retain clear separation between petrol blue, mustard, rust and the gray ground. Place the quilt in the lower two-thirds, with enough space above for the headline. Set "A SOFT CHAPTER" in slightly irregular handwritten lettering, then "A quiet place between the folds." in smaller handwriting. Include one subtle curved underline. These are the only words.

The image should read first as a real quilt, then reveal a small, comforting illustrated story. Keep the composition rich in tactile detail but organized around one object and one adult. No real brands, logos, watermarks, decorative icons, duplicate figures or invented publication marks. No childlike body proportions. Maintain believable perspective, shared lighting and clear hands holding the book.

—

Larus Canus

一张九比十六竖版电影感生活摄影，平视三分之二身构图。一位完全虚构的四十岁东亚女性在雨天傍晚的小厨房准备晚饭。她留着深棕短发，穿深青色不透肤长袖棉衫、铁锈红帆布围裙和深灰长裤，没有首饰与妆面修饰。她专注地低头看锅，嘴角自然放松，身体微微侧向炉灶。

在中央巨兽左侧，一只狼与怪物潮并行奔跑，体型明显小于巨兽，毛色偏灰黄，神态警觉，增强了尺度对比与叙事感。画面前景遍布大量密集的小型虫怪与蛛形怪，贴地快速爬行，外壳粗糙、肢体尖锐，部分前景生物被近距离放大并略微虚焦。画面左侧前景有一只超近距离的大型甲壳怪物被裁切进入画面，只露出局部身体和肢体，形成强烈压迫感与前景遮挡式构图。中景与远景中还分布着多只同类巨型角兽，正在成群推进。天空中密布无数飞虫，在高空与雾尘中盘旋飞舞，形成遮天蔽日的灾厄感。

环境是被黄沙、尘暴和体积光笼罩的荒原或废墟边缘，远处隐约可见朦胧的巨大建筑、残骸或城池轮廓，但被光雾和沙尘大幅吞没。主光来自画面右后上方，强烈暖白色日光穿过尘埃，形成大面积体积散射和逆光边缘辉光，整体色调为沙土米黄、暖灰、尘雾白、铁锈棕和深褐色，低饱和、电影化、压抑而宏大。画面具有清晰的前中后景层次：前景虫群，中景主角巨兽与狼，远景巨兽军团和飞虫群。镜头具有广角电影感，空间纵深明显，近大远小强烈，快门定格冲锋瞬间，但保留扬尘、飞沙和空气颗粒带来的动态气氛。

p: Vintage-style Christmas illustration featuring a young girl in a red coat and plaid skirt hugging a stylized reindeer. The reindeer has ornaments and garland on its antlers and a bell around its neck. A small basket with holly and gifts sits at the reindeer's feet. The design uses a distressed, screen-printed texture with a limited color palette of red, green, and white. At the top, the text "HAVE YOURSELF A MERRY LITTLE CHRISTMAS" is arched in a bold, retro font. The overall aesthetic is nostalgic, mid-century holiday art.

Convierte toda la fotografía subida en una ilustración de dibujos animados en 2D, colorida, limpia y hecha a mano. Conserva la composición original, el ángulo de la cámara, las poses, las expresiones faciales, las identidades reconocibles, los peinados, la ropa, los accesorios y todos los elementos importantes del fondo.

ESTILO DE LA ILUSTRACIÓN:
- Contornos negros limpios con un grosor de línea ligeramente variable, como si estuvieran dibujados a mano.
- Colores pastel planos con un sombreado tipo cel shading mínimo.
- Personajes simplificados con proporciones adorables, rostros expresivos y poses naturales.
- Líneas suaves, ligeramente imperfectas, para conseguir un aspecto ilustrado auténtico.
- Simplifica las texturas realistas convirtiéndolas en formas limpias, sin perder los detalles reconocibles.
- Recrea el entorno original, incluidos edificios, árboles, fuentes, caminos y otros objetos, utilizando el mismo estilo de dibujos animados.
- Utiliza una paleta de colores pastel suaves, con cielos azul claro, verdes apagados, tonos de piel cálidos y delicados matices rosados.
- Añade detalles artísticos sutiles, manteniendo la atmósfera de la escena original.

CONSERVAR LA IMAGEN ORIGINAL:

Mantén el mismo número de personas, sus posiciones, las proporciones corporales, los colores de la ropa, las interacciones y los tamaños relativos. Conserva la distribución del fondo original y su perspectiva. No añadas, elimines ni cambies de posición ningún objeto importante.

REQUISITOS DEL RESULTADO:

Una ilustración 2D pulida, que ocupe todo el encuadre, con contornos uniformes, colores planos y una estética alegre, propia de un libro de cuentos ilustrado. Toda la imagen debe estar ilustrada, sin ningún elemento fotorrealista.

EVITAR: Renderizados en 3D, fotorrealismo, sombreado excesivo, texturas de acuarela, líneas borrosas, rostros deformados, dedos o extremidades adicionales, cambios de vestuario, poses modificadas, detalles del fondo omitidos y texto o marcas de agua no deseados.

Relación de aspecto: Reproduce exactamente la de la fotografía subida.

Consejo profesional: Sube una fotografía cada vez y utiliza este mismo prompt para transformar distintas fotografías con el fin de mantener un estilo de dibujos animados uniforme y coherente.

A Cannes-level commercial poster for the fictional rugged-tech brand TERRAVAULT, designed as a product-first four-environment performance campaign. Fuse cinematic environmental storytelling, collector-grade industrial precision, and graphic restraint. Preserve a perfectly divided 2x2 grid with four saturated monochrome fields, four miniature terrain stages, four extreme-sport athletes, a central TERRAVAULT wordmark crossing the seam, and a row of compact capability icons. The same TERRAVAULT ultra-rugged smartphone must remain the undisputed hero in all four panels, dominating water, mud, dust, and whitewater impact scenarios.

Use a square poster split into four exact quadrants with crisp boundaries. Top-left: vivid ocean cyan. Top-right: mineral amber-gold. Bottom-left: ember red-orange. Bottom-right: deep river blue. In every quadrant, the same oversized vertical TERRAVAULT phone rises from or is embedded in a micro-terrain pedestal, while one athlete stays clearly secondary in scale. Across the central seam, place a large custom white TERRAVAULT wordmark, perfectly centered. Above or below it, align four compact square icons for water, mud, dust, and impact resistance. The read must be immediate: product first, environment second, athlete third.

TERRAVAULT is a luxury expedition-grade rugged smartphone with a black titanium frame, matte ceramic back, reinforced corners, precision gasket seams, anti-slip side texture, a subtly raised lens housing, armored bevel transitions, and a refined industrial silhouette that feels premium, not utilitarian. The design must stay identical across all four quadrants, with each environment adding only specific traces: sea droplets and salt sheen in surf, drying clay and root-stained mud in trail, warm mineral dust and red grit in motocross, and cold spray beads with wet rock reflections in paddle.

Quadrant staging: top-left shows a female surfer on a shallow ocean-water stage with a curling wave behind her and the phone rising like a dark monolith from wet sand and surf. Top-right shows a mountain biker beside a mud-covered bike on a compact earth-and-root plinth, with the phone embedded like a precision survival slab. Bottom-left shows a motocross rider and dirt bike on a dusty red-earth pedestal, with the phone as the dominant anchor amid restrained dust bloom. Bottom-right shows a whitewater paddler on a rock-and-foam platform with paddle in hand, the phone emerging from river stone and churning spray with a small waterfall integrated into the stage. In all panels, the athletes remain smaller and subordinate.

Each quadrant should feel like a collectible micro-world: ocean foam, wet sand, mud, roots, red dust, rocks, moss, and whitewater must look tactile and real, but tightly edited so the poster never gets busy. Add richer environmental traces than a studio packshot—clinging droplets, drying mud, low suspended dust, cold mist near river spray—while keeping the worlds compact, graphic, and sculptural like museum-grade product dioramas.

Use a disciplined 60/25/10/5 logic in each panel: 60% dominant field color, 25% natural terrain tones, 10% product graphite-black titanium, 5% white brand accents and specular highlights. Keep a unified premium studio lighting system across all quadrants so the phone holds consistent industrial definition: crisp frontal shaping, subtle top-edge highlights, and clean side contour separation. Then add panel-specific behavior: cool aquatic reflections in surf, matte earthy scatter in trail, warm dusty bounce in motocross, and bright wet speculars with cool spray diffusion in paddle. Contrast should feel vivid and campaign-bold, never toy-like or over-processed.

Render everything as hyper-real premium advertising photography fused with collector-grade diorama realism. The phone must show machined titanium density, matte ceramic restraint, tactile gaskets, lens-glass depth, and believable environmental interaction. Water should feel fluid and translucent, mud heavy and viscous, red dust dry and powdery, and whitewater cold, forceful, and aerated. Athlete gear should be authentic and restrained. Every micro-stage must feel physically grounded and precisely art-directed.

Place the main white TERRAVAULT wordmark across the central seam in bold custom geometric type. Add the smaller line: Built For Every Element. Keep the four feature icons compact, graphic, and aligned with the brand system. Typography must function as central poster architecture, sharp and legible, never muddy, never covering key device edges, and never overwhelming the products.

No inconsistent phone design across quadrants, no duplicated athletes, no broken anatomy, no warped bikes or boards, no floating terrain, no chaotic splash clutter, no muddy typography, no gibberish text, no cheap gamer aesthetic, no excessive particles, no topology collapse, no style drift, no flat catalog lighting.
